name: Wine
description: A wine bottle in a user's WineKeeper collection.

name.description: Name of the wine (e.g. specific cuvée or product name)

region.description: Wine region (e.g. Napa Valley, Bordeaux, Tuscany)

appellation.description: Appellation or sub-region (e.g. Pauillac, Rutherford, Barossa Valley)

varietal.description: Primary grape variety (e.g. Cabernet Sauvignon, Chardonnay)

blend_components.description: Grape varieties in the blend (e.g. ["Cabernet Sauvignon", "Merlot"])

style.description: Style or color category of the wine

drink_window_start.description: Start of the recommended drinking window (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY)

drink_window_end.description: End of the recommended drinking window (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY)

peak_window_start.description: Start of the peak drinking window (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY)

peak_window_end.description: End of the peak drinking window (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY)

storage_location_id.description: Foreign key to a StorageLocation record

bin.description: Bin label or identifier within the storage location

rack_position.description: Specific rack or slot position within the bin

notes.description: Free-text personal notes about this wine

is_favorite.description: Whether this wine is marked as a favorite

ai_excluded.description: Whether this wine is excluded from AI recommendations

public_visibility.description: Whether this wine is visible to other users on public profiles

created_by.description: Email of the user who created this record

created_date.description: ISO timestamp when this record was created

updated_date.description: ISO timestamp when this record was last updated
